_comment: THE EDIT-DOOR REGISTRY (Brian, 2026-09-20, edit after create). scripts/edit-doors.mjs joins this file with the API's own route registrations (app.post / app.patch / app.put under apps/api/src/modules) and prints one row per entity; scripts/check-edit-doors.mjs fails the root chain on any POST route this file does not classify, on any entity whose create control (createUi) has no update route with a UI caller (updateUi) unless it is marked immutable, and on any claim here the code contradicts (a createUi that does not call the route, a noCreateControl over a route some Ops screen does call). Paths are 'METHOD /path' as registered, :params kept.

excluded./portal/: the client's own screens; Ops edits nothing there
excluded./public/: no session: the client's own acts on an emailed link
excluded./jobs/: scheduled jobs, run by the tick

entities.immutable: edited by superseding: a draft is withdrawn with a reason and rebuilt; a sent quote pins its price-book version and is the client's to answer; a change to accepted work is a change-order quote
a document assembled from the record and signed as assembled; a change is a new packet, never an edit of one sent for signature

entities.noCreateControl: issued by quote acceptance, the final fee and notice billing; Ops issues none by hand
entities.immutable: an issued document: voided or refunded through their own audited doors, never edited
named once; its content is its columns and cards, each moved or added through their own doors

entities.noCreateControl: columns are seeded with the board; no Ops screen adds one
entities.immutable: named once; cards move between columns
a snapshot of its filters and sort; changed by saving the view again, not by editing the saved one

entities.noCreateControl: no Ops screen posts one yet; the task drawer reads them
entities.immutable: what was said, when it was said

entities.noCreateControl: no Ops screen adds one yet

entities.immutable: a link between two tasks: added or removed, nothing on it to edit

entities.noCreateControl: seeded definitions; API only
started by the task timer, not typed
entities.immutable: a timer record: started and stopped
approved and sent as composed (approval-gated, unsubscribe appended at send); a change is a new broadcast

entities.noCreateControl: no Ops screen creates one; events arrive by seed and API
entities.immutable: published and completed as created; registrations are their own records

entities.noCreateControl: seeded from meetings (seed-sop) and the API; the SOP screen reads
no Ops screen creates one yet; notices are entered through the API and inbound mail
status tracking only; no Ops screen creates one yet
no Ops screen creates one yet
groups come from the onboarding form and the API; the group screens are not built
memberships come from the onboarding form and the API
entities.immutable: a membership is added, never edited

entities.noCreateControl: derived for each business by the compliance job; no Ops screen creates one
entities.immutable: a derived obligation, marked filed through its own door

entities.noCreateControl: no Ops screen creates one yet
entities.immutable: a ledger of steps for one period; steps are recorded, the period never changes

entities.noCreateControl: scheduled through the record's schedule-session door; no free-form create in Ops
entities.immutable: a scheduled occurrence; rescheduling is a new session

entities.noCreateControl: raised by the chase job; no Ops screen creates one
entities.immutable: a request as made; fulfilment and chasing are the record

entities.noCreateControl: created by quote acceptance; the API opens one by hand
entities.immutable: no free-form edit by design: each field has its own audited door in return-controls.tsx (estimate, final fee, preparer, extension, transition, signatures, paper mailing)

entities.noCreateControl: no Ops screen creates one yet
entities.immutable: a case as opened; representation and forms are its own doors

entities.noCreateControl: the remote e-sign path is retired; nothing in Ops creates one
entities.immutable: an issued envelope
an uploaded report; its rows are held, unheld and released through their own doors
an uploaded recording; its recap is drafted and edited through PATCH /meetings/:id/recap
effective-dated and versioned: a price change is a new version, never an edit of one in force

entities.noCreateControl: suggested from the record and the portal; no free-form create in Ops
entities.immutable: approved, declined or sent as suggested
an uploaded file, scanned and filed as uploaded; withdrawn or superseded by another upload, never edited, every access audited

entities.noCreateControl: created by quote acceptance; the API opens one by hand
entities.immutable: no free-form edit by design: each change is its own audited door (configure, maintenance mode, pause, resume, close, period, deposit transfer)
composed from the price book only and saved by the CEO alone; a change is a new package, and the discount is admin-set at publish
